Filling the search box with `#tag` when I click a tag is exactly right because it makes the filter visible and easy to adjust.

I’d expect `#news` to match the exact tag only. A bookmark tagged `newsletter` should not appear; I could search ordinary text if I wanted a partial match.

The rest of the search behavior sounds right. One small presentation issue: if a bookmark matches only because of its note, please show the relevant note excerpt with the match highlighted so I can understand why it appeared. With those changes, search will meet my needs.
